| Friends, Minnesota is back in the national spotlight... and for all the wrong reasons.
Federal agents have launched what they’re calling a massive investigation into alleged daycare fraud in Minnesota. Homeland Security, ICE, and the FBI were already on the ground with personnel and resources.
Now, a viral, independent investigative video showed largely inactive childcare centers receiving **millions** in taxpayer dollars. One center, barely operational, was supposedly serving 99 children and received roughly **$4 million** in state funds. Even the sign on the building was misspelled.
This isn’t a one-off. It’s part of a pattern.
Under Governor Tim Walz, Minnesota has already lost **hundreds of millions—possibly billions—** to fraud tied to social services programs. Federal officials have said these cases may only be “the tip of a very large iceberg.”
And yet Walz keeps insisting everything is “well-run.”
It’s not.
That’s why I’m fighting in Congress, pushing legislation to expose fraud, demand transparency, and hold state governments accountable when they refuse to cooperate with oversight over federal tax dollars.
But here’s the reality: taking on entrenched bureaucracies, a Democratic governor, and a media machine that runs cover for these scandals isn’t easy.
If you’re fed up with your tax dollars being stolen while liberal politicians look the other way, now is the moment to act.
Please chip in today to help me keep up the fight to expose fraud, protect taxpayers, and force accountability in Minnesota

body:
What you need to know about Deb's race for governor in New Mexico

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=6482%2E400544%2EA6UDsL)
---
Hi there, it's Dylan, Deb's Campaign Manager.

I hope you are having a joyful and restful holiday season. As we close out the year, I wanted to share a quick strategy memo on the state of Deb's race in New Mexico and why your support right now is essential to success in 2026.

**[But before you read my full memo below, will you please consider making a donation of $5, or anything at all, to help reach our $50,000 goal before the end of the year?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/3232?t=2&akid=6482%2E400544%2EA6UDsL)**
| | [Donate >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/3232?t=3&akid=6482%2E400544%2EA6UDsL)
---
| | **Deb for New Mexico Campaign Strategy Memo
Dec. 29, 2025
**
---
_**STATE OF THE RACE:**_**_This is NOT a safe blue seat._**

---
* The party of New Mexico's governor has flipped every eight years for decades.

---
* Races up and down the ballot here are getting closer and closer, with Democratic margins SHRINKING between 2018 and 2024.

---
* With an outgoing two-term Democratic governor, Republicans are expecting to flip this seat. Deb is already facing right-wing attacks and multiple self-funding multimillionaire GOP opponents, and this race could see unprecedented dark money pouring into New Mexico.

---
| | **_WHO DEB IS:__Deb's running a different kind of campaign._**
---
* Unlike her opponents, Deb doesn't come from wealth, and she's not backed by billionaires — this campaign is powered by the people.

---
* In the first six months of the campaign, she built a true grassroots movement, visiting and earning support in all 33 counties in New Mexico and holding events in every corner of the state.

---
* From Shiprock to Las Cruces, Deb has stood alongside workers fighting for better **wages – even joining picket lines – listened** to people struggling with healthcare, affordability, safety in their communities and more.

---
* She’s ready to make progress for New Mexican families and fight for a brighter future for each and every one of us. And with Donald Trump slashing programs like Medicaid and SNAP, the stakes couldn't be higher.

---
**But she can’t do it alone.**
---
| | **_HOW CAN YOU HELP?_This is where you come in__**
---
* A grassroots campaign like this one relies on everyday people like you chipping in what you can, when you can — $5 here, $25 there, that's how Deb is going to raise the resources she needs to keep New Mexico blue.

---
* We know this will be one of the most competitive and expensive races in the country next year. If we wait until then to kick our fundraising into high gear, it'll already be too late.

---
* To set us up for success, we have an ambitious — but necessary — end-of-year goal of $50,000. Reaching this goal will ensure Deb can fight back against her self-funding opponents' attacks, get ads on the air in critical markets, and continue traveling across the state connecting with voters.

---
**[Can we count on your support before the end of the year to help us get there and make sure Deb has the resources she needs going into this critical election year?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/3232?t=4&akid=6482%2E400544%2EA6UDsL)**
---
Thank you for reading and for anything you're able to contribute. I know it means the world to Deb to have you on our team, and we are all so so proud of the movement we are building together.

Best wishes for a safe and happy new year,

Dylan McArthur
Campaign Manager
Deb for New Mexico

What do they know about winning in New Hampshire?
**Peter, I’m sorry about Karoline Leavitt.**
Before she was hand-picked as Donald Trump’s White House Press Secretary, Karoline ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. She lost — by nearly 10 points.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/98899?refcode=em20251229-9868&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9868%2E614464%2EeSVEDC)
But that campaign gave her exactly what she needed: A test run for the MAGA talking points she now repeats from behind the White House podium. She’s been practicing the spin for years — and while **New Hampshire wasn’t buying it** , Trump was.
Let me be clear: I don’t regret a thing about standing up to Karoline and her MAGA agenda — not then and not now.
This race is going to be tough. National Republicans and John Sununu are doing everything they can to flip this seat. They’re recycling the same extremist ideas, running the same playbook, and relying on people like Karoline Leavitt to carry their message.
**We beat her once, and with your help, we’ll do it again.**

Ivan Dmytrovych Sirko was born in the early seventeenth century, approximately between 1605 and 1610. This is evidenced primarily by the results of research on Sirko's remains, according to which the Cossack ataman was 70-75 years old at the time of his death in 1680. The first researcher of Sirko's biography, the famous Ukrainian historian Dmytro Yavornytskyi, suggested that the future ataman was born in Sloboda Ukraine in the settlement of Merefa (now the city of Merefa, Kharkiv region). However, this is not true. Merefa was founded only in 1658, i.e. when Sirko was in his late teens. However, Sirko and his family lived in Merefa for a long time in his house, and after his death, his wife and some family members lived there. The fact that Merefa in Slobozhanshchyna is associated with the name of the Cossack Ataman is evidenced by another name for the town recorded in some Ukrainian chronicles, Sirkivka. Where, then, should we look for Sirko's homeland? In our opinion, the sources give grounds to localize it in Eastern Podillia, namely in the Vinnytsia region. It is worth recalling that Sirko was a colonel in Vinnytsia (Kalnytsia) in 1658-1660. As you know, at that time in Ukraine, people who came from the local area were usually elected to such positions. Let us also recall a letter from Hetman of the Left Bank Ukraine Ivan Samoilovych to the tsarist voivode Prince G. Romodanovsky of April 20, 1675*, which recounts (in Russian) Sirko's own words: "And since I was born among the Poles, I want to die there." Thus, it is clear that Sirko was born on the Ukrainian lands that were under the rule of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, not Muscovy (the latter included Slobozhanshchyna). The historian Volodymyr Borysenko's assumption that Sirko's birthplace was the hundred-man town of the Bratslav regiment Murafa, a few kilometers from Kalnyk, is correct. Now it is the village of Zhdanov, Vinnytsia region. By the way, Murafa in the Slobozhanshchyna probably originated from this Murafa, because immigrants from the Right Bank of Ukraine to the Left Bank often gave the newly founded settlements the names of their native villages or towns. It is also worth noting Sirko's great interest in Keleberda, which he founded in 1675 on the left bank of the Dnipro. For a long time, he sought from the Moscow tsar the right to own this town or sloboda, as well as the strategically important crossing of the Dnipro near Perevolochna (Sirko wanted this crossing not for himself, but for the entire Zaporozhian Lowland Army). Contrary to popular belief, we believe that Sirko did not come from a Cossack family, but from a small Ukrainian Orthodox gentry. For example, we know the name of a Podillia nobleman, Voytekh Sirko, who was married to a certain Olena Kozynska. Sources mention them in 1592. It is possible that they were relatives of the Cossack leader. Perhaps it is no coincidence that the kings of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, writing to Sirko, called him "urodzon." The word "nobleman" evokes negative associations for many people due to stereotypes instilled in school textbooks of the Stalinist era. However, this approach is not always correct. The term "nobleman" is identical to the words "knight," "chevalier," "nobleman," etc. and was commonly used not only in Poland but also in Ukraine, Belarus, and the Czech Republic. If scholars in Russia, Poland, and the Czech Republic, having contracted vulgar sociologism, no longer accuse Pushkin or Bunin, Suvorov or Kutuzov, Žižka or Kostiushko of being of noble or gentry origin, why have attacks on the Ukrainian and Belarusian gentry continued until recently? Is it not because in this way the imperial "divide and conquer" was transferred to our long-suffering history? Was it not because it was necessary to impose a nihilistic attitude toward the history of Ukraine, to "prove" that Ukrainians or Belarusians were just dark labor without national consciousness, ethnographic material doomed to build other people's empires? Meanwhile, the Ukrainian gentry produced many outstanding sons of Ukraine, fighters for its freedom. Suffice it to mention the names of Kryshtof Kosinski, Petro Konashevych-Sahaidachny, Ivan Sulyma, Ivan Mazepa, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, and his associates: Ivan and Danylo Vyhovsky, Ivan Bohun, Danylo and Ivan Nechai, Mykhailo Krychevsky, Jan Sokolovsky, Siluyan Muzhylovsky, and others. Sirko's appearance and personality do not always coincide with the conventional ideas about him that have developed in some works of art. The Cossack leader was slightly taller than average (174-176 cm), had regular facial features, and a straight nose. By the way, the great Relin intuitively caught this when he depicted him in the center of his painting "Cossacks Writing a Letter to the Turkish Sultan." It is interesting that the prototype for Sirko's image in the painting was the famous military leader General Dragomirov. Only one significant detail was not known to Repin and his consultant D. Yavornytskyi - a red birthmark on Sirko's lower lip on the right side. His contemporaries considered it a "sign of God" given to distinguish him from ordinary people. The Grand Hetman of the Crown, the future King of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Jan Sobieski, who knew Sirko well and met him in Bratslav in 1671.

name: FEC Update from Marie
subject: This is crunch time
body:
| | Peter – I ran for Congress because I was tired of politicians rubber-stamping the agenda of party bosses while communities like ours were left behind.

This year, we’ve seen the consequences of D.C.’s misplaced priorities as Majority leaders dig in their heels time after time, and refuse to work across the aisle for solutions that *actually* help working families.

Here in Southwest Washington, when things get hard, we don’t back down – we roll up our sleeves and get to work.

December 29, 2025
Once again, you have the privilege of being among the true cognoscenti, in that you are now about the read my predictions for 2026, which have made multiple fortunes for regular readers who immediately go to the betting sites after reading this annual article.

But before we proceed, we will do what few other prognosticators do, review last year's predictions:
The Stock Market will gain 5%. Hopefully you did not bet on this as my firm belief that the stock market is overvalued has been proven wrong again - or at least deferred. The S & P Index gained 17%.
President Trump's popularity will be 50% or higher for the first time. Correct. President Trump crossed this threshold several times according to reputable pollsters although presently he is in the mid to low forties.
There will be cease fires in both the Ukraine and Israeli Wars. Half right. A tenuous cease fire has occurred in the Mideast but President Trump's efforts to stop the killing in Ukraine have not born fruit.
President Trump will succeed in deporting violent illegal immigrants. Correct. While a few liberal judges have been able to slow this process, President Trump has deported 650,000 illegals and almost two million have left voluntarily.
Inflation will decrease. Correct but inflation has not decreased as much as it needs to. This is President Trump's main liability at this point.
The Supreme Court will allow the banning of transgender treatments. Correct
The Steelers will win the Super Bowl. Sadly incorrect. We got beaten in the first round of the play offs
The Steelers will make the playoffs again. Undecided but unlikely. We need to beat the Ravens this weekend to win our division. Unless the same ref (whose seeing eye dog was not allowed on the field for some reason) that stole the Raven's touchdown in our last encounter is on the field again, the momentum is in the Raven's favor.
Penn State will win the National Title. Incorrect. We lost to Notre Dame in the semi-finals but at least we were preserved the ignominy of being pounded by the eventual winner, Ohio State.
The UConn Men will make the Elite Eight. Wrong. But that was because of horrible officiating our 77-75 loss to Florida.
The UConn Women will make the finals. Correct. We actually won the whole thing.

Now for 2026.
The Stock Market will be flat, but the Dow will hit 50,000. The forward valuations are too high; the tech stocks are way overvalued and not every company will make a fortune in AI.

The Republicans will hold the Senate. Republicans presently have a 53 to 47 majority and just by luck, there are not many competitive races they could lose. The main three are North Carolina (Republican), Maine (Republican) and Georgia (Democrat). Even if the Republicans loss these two seats, they will still have a majority. Michigan (Democrat), Ohio (Republican) and New Hampshire (Democrat) have open seats, but they will probably not change.

The Republicans will hold the House. This is against the popular wisdom as Democrats have been winning the few elections that have occurred in 2025 by larger margins than expected. But this is misleading because the Democrats passionately despise Trump and show up in droves while the Republicans are sitting at home watching Netflix. This will not be the case in 2026.

The Ukraine War will not end. Those who were optimistic, myself included, now realize that Putin wants to conquer the entire Ukraine and will not stop the war otherwise. The only impediment would be if Europe and the United States sent troops into Ukraine while allowing Ukraine fighter pilots to bomb Moscow. This risks a nuclear war.
Maduro will be deposed in Venezuela. President Trump has stopped the flow of oil out of Venezuela and the people are behind Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado who won the last election by 70% until Maduro threw out the results.
Ryan Fazio will be the Republican gubernatorial nominee for Connecticut. Presently, the front runner appears to be former New Britian mayor Erin Stewart, but she is perceived by many Republicans as being too liberal. There is talk of former New York Lieutenant Governor Betsy McCaughey (pronounced McCoy) throwing her hat into the ring as she is now a Greenwich resident. But she will have difficulty as a political outsider receiving the necessary 15% at the Republican Convention to obtain a place on the primary ballot. Gathering signatures to circumvent this is a tedious expense process. Plus, I like her, meaning she is too conservative to win.
Ned Lamont will win reelection. Connecticut is a Deep Blue state, and no Republican has won a statewide race since 2006. When you add up all the state and municipal workers - retired and still working, those on public assistance and affluent suburban Trump-hating whites, the number exceeds 50%.
The Supreme Court will declare race-based congressional districts unconstitutional (Louisiana v. Callais).
The Supreme Court will disallow Trump's tariff policies but not retroactively. (Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump).
The Supreme Court will allow birthright citizenship (Barbara v. Trump). Presently, if a pregnant woman illegally enters the country and gives birth in an American hospital, that child is an American citizen. This is unlikely to change
The Steelers will win the Super Bowl. Readers may wonder how this can happen when I previously stated that we will probably not make the play offs. But anyone who has difficulty grasping this reasoning does not know any Steeler fans.

The UConn Men will make the Final Four. Presently we are ranked eighth, but our record is 12-1 and we are first in the Big East. Hurley is a great coach and teams like Duke and Gonzaga will choke at the end.
The UConn Women will win it all. Presently we are ranked first and have a 12-0 record. Unless one of our stars is seriously injured, things are looking good.
Ohio State will win the national football championship. Yes, I know they lost to Indiana 13-10 but that was a fluke. Ohio State's team is a wrecking crew.

clean_body: For those who want to be in the know | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more For those who want to be in the know | | | Dec 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | December 29, 2025 Once again, you have the privilege of being among the true cognoscenti, in that you are now about the read my predictions for 2026, which have made multiple fortunes for regular readers who immediately go to the betting sites after reading this annual article. But before we proceed, we will do what few other prognosticators do, review last year's predictions: The Stock Market will gain 5%. Hopefully you did not bet on this as my firm belief that the stock market is overvalued has been proven wrong again - or at least deferred. The S & P Index gained 17%. President Trump's popularity will be 50% or higher for the first time. Correct. President Trump crossed this threshold several times according to reputable pollsters although presently he is in the mid to low forties. There will be cease fires in both the Ukraine and Israeli Wars. Half right. A tenuous cease fire has occurred in the Mideast but President Trump's efforts to stop the killing in Ukraine have not born fruit. President Trump will succeed in deporting violent illegal immigrants. Correct. While a few liberal judges have been able to slow this process, President Trump has deported 650,000 illegals and almost two million have left voluntarily. Inflation will decrease. Correct but inflation has not decreased as much as it needs to. This is President Trump's main liability at this point. The Supreme Court will allow the banning of transgender treatments. Correct The Steelers will win the Super Bowl. Sadly incorrect. We got beaten in the first round of the play offs The Steelers will make the playoffs again. Undecided but unlikely. We need to beat the Ravens this weekend to win our division. Unless the same ref (whose seeing eye dog was not allowed on the field for some reason) that stole the Raven's touchdown in our last encounter is on the field again, the momentum is in the Raven's favor. Penn State will win the National Title. Incorrect. We lost to Notre Dame in the semi-finals but at least we were preserved the ignominy of being pounded by the eventual winner, Ohio State. The UConn Men will make the Elite Eight. Wrong. But that was because of horrible officiating our 77-75 loss to Florida. The UConn Women will make the finals. Correct. We actually won the whole thing. Now for 2026. The Stock Market will be flat, but the Dow will hit 50,000. The forward valuations are too high; the tech stocks are way overvalued and not every company will make a fortune in AI. The Republicans will hold the Senate. Republicans presently have a 53 to 47 majority and just by luck, there are not many competitive races they could lose. The main three are North Carolina (Republican), Maine (Republican) and Georgia (Democrat). Even if the Republicans loss these two seats, they will still have a majority. Michigan (Democrat), Ohio (Republican) and New Hampshire (Democrat) have open seats, but they will probably not change. The Republicans will hold the House. This is against the popular wisdom as Democrats have been winning the few elections that have occurred in 2025 by larger margins than expected. But this is misleading because the Democrats passionately despise Trump and show up in droves while the Republicans are sitting at home watching Netflix. This will not be the case in 2026. The Ukraine War will not end. Those who were optimistic, myself included, now realize that Putin wants to conquer the entire Ukraine and will not stop the war otherwise. The only impediment would be if Europe and the United States sent troops into Ukraine while allowing Ukraine fighter pilots to bomb Moscow. This risks a nuclear war. Maduro will be deposed in Venezuela. President Trump has stopped the flow of oil out of Venezuela and the people are behind Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado who won the last election by 70% until Maduro threw out the results. Ryan Fazio will be the Republican gubernatorial nominee for Connecticut. Presently, the front runner appears to be former New Britian mayor Erin Stewart, but she is perceived by many Republicans as being too liberal. There is talk of former New York Lieutenant Governor Betsy McCaughey (pronounced McCoy) throwing her hat into the ring as she is now a Greenwich resident. But she will have difficulty as a political outsider receiving the necessary 15% at the Republican Convention to obtain a place on the primary ballot. Gathering signatures to circumvent this is a tedious expense process. Plus, I like her, meaning she is too conservative to win. Ned Lamont will win reelection. Connecticut is a Deep Blue state, and no Republican has won a statewide race since 2006. When you add up all the state and municipal workers - retired and still working, those on public assistance and affluent suburban Trump-hating whites, the number exceeds 50%. The Supreme Court will declare race-based congressional districts unconstitutional (Louisiana v. Callais). The Supreme Court will disallow Trump's tariff policies but not retroactively. (Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump). The Supreme Court will allow birthright citizenship (Barbara v. Trump). Presently, if a pregnant woman illegally enters the country and gives birth in an American hospital, that child is an American citizen. This is unlikely to change The Steelers will win the Super Bowl. Readers may wonder how this can happen when I previously stated that we will probably not make the play offs. But anyone who has difficulty grasping this reasoning does not know any Steeler fans. The UConn Men will make the Final Four. Presently we are ranked eighth, but our record is 12-1 and we are first in the Big East. Hurley is a great coach and teams like Duke and Gonzaga will choke at the end. The UConn Women will win it all. Presently we are ranked first and have a 12-0 record. Unless one of our stars is seriously injured, things are looking good. Ohio State will win the national football championship. Yes, I know they lost to Indiana 13-10 but that was a fluke. Ohio State's team is a wrecking crew. subject: My decision
body:
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
| Hey Peter, it’s Mark Kelly. Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate. I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy. But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something. So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too. I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help. We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now. After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. I need your help by Wednesday.
#
Peter, our December end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is on Wednesday and we haven’t yet met our goal, so I do have to ask for your financial support in these final days, but I also want to explain just why I keep reaching out **[(if you don’t need to read more, you can click here to give).](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/99037?refcode=em20251229-9889&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9889%2E614464%2E8OAdKQ)**
**I ask because there’s so much work we must do for this country:** Far-right lawmakers are placing limits on who can vote and preventing women from accessing the abortion care they need. They are slashing resources from students and educators because it’s politically convenient. They are cutting taxes for the rich by decimating health care access for the rest of us. _We have to stop the harm that extreme Republicans are causing._
**I ask because this is the most competitive race I’ve ever run:** This is a 50-50 state. Winning statewide elections here is never easy, but I have experience taking on the toughest fights. I know that we can win again as long as we work together — but we're up against a united GOP. Republicans see this seat as the key to their Senate majority, and they see me as their top threat. That’s why they are willing to go to any lengths to defeat me. Powerful politicians, mega-donors, dark-money groups... they’re all lining up behind my opponent. _I’m humbly asking for your help to take them on._
**[As of our last check, we are concerned we might not hit our target. In a race this competitive, a single misstep could cause us to lose the momentum. We can’t afford to fall short. If there is any amount that you can spare tonight, it would go a long way. name: Case Dixon
subject: Dixon Campaign Update
body:
**Hello everyone,**

I hope you all had a great **Christmas** and were able to spend some precious time with family. As we close out the year, I wanted to share a brief update on the campaign and where things stand going into the new year.

**New Campaign Video**

In December we released a **[new campaign video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z2XL9W3C_-M "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z2XL9W3C_-M")** outlining why I’m running and what I believe needs to change in Washington. It reflects the same message I’ve been taking across the district: the debt crisis, rising costs, and the lack of accountability from my opponent.

**Radio and Podcast Appearances**

I’ve continued getting our message out through longer-form conversations, including:
* A second appearance on **[Joey Clark Live](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vRxNlClIHkY&t=1086s "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vRxNlClIHkY&t=1086s")**
* A podcast interview with **[Jason Will](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VDURzWWLNaw&t=865s "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VDURzWWLNaw&t=865s")**
* A podcast conversation with **[Murray Edwards](https://thenewscasters.com/podcast/alabama-politics-case-dixon-candidate-for-congress-hd6/ "https://thenewscasters.com/podcast/alabama-politics-case-dixon-candidate-for-congress-hd6/")**

These discussions allowed me to go deeper on the national debt, economic pressures facing families, adherence to the Constitution, and why Republicans will keep losing ground if we don’t start addressing these issues honestly.

**News Coverage and Public Statements**

As the national debt surpassed **$38 trillion** in October, I spoke out publicly about the GOP’s failure to address it and the inflationary consequences that continue to erode the purchasing power of American families. **[Read here.](https://www.alreporter.com/2025/10/24/republican-congressional-candidate-calls-out-gop-for-failing-to-address-national-debt/ "https://www.alreporter.com/2025/10/24/republican-congressional-candidate-calls-out-gop-for-failing-to-address-national-debt/")**

During the **longest government shutdown** in our **history** , I called on my opponent to decline his congressional pay, as many members of Congress, including members of Alabama’s delegation, chose to do. He did not. **[Read here.](https://alpolitics.com/case-dixon-calls-on-rep-gary-palmer-to-decline-pay-during-government-shutdown/ "https://alpolitics.com/case-dixon-calls-on-rep-gary-palmer-to-decline-pay-during-government-shutdown/")**

Other recent coverage included:

* [Urging the President not to import beef from Argentina and instead put American cattlemen first via the Prime Act and Mandatory Country of Origin Labeling.](https://alpolitics.com/dixon-responds-to-trump-argentina-may-be-fighting-for-its-life-but-american-cattlemen-are-fighting-for-theirs/ "https://alpolitics.com/dixon-responds-to-trump-argentina-may-be-fighting-for-its-life-but-american-cattlemen-are-fighting-for-theirs/")

* [Saying plainly that Republicans will continue to lose elections until economic issues are taken seriously](https://www.alreporter.com/2025/11/06/alabama-republican-candidate-calls-on-gop-to-address-economic-issues/ "https://www.alreporter.com/2025/11/06/alabama-republican-candidate-calls-on-gop-to-address-economic-issues/")

* [Supporting the Epstein Files Transparency Act vote as a win for victims](https://alpolitics.com/dixon-says-epstein-files-vote-is-a-win-for-victims/ "https://alpolitics.com/dixon-says-epstein-files-vote-is-a-win-for-victims/")

* [Pointing out that a preventable terror attack in Washington exposed the dangers of reckless Afghan visa expansion](https://alpolitics.com/case-dixon-d-c-attack-exposes-dangers-of-reckless-afghan-visa-expansion-this-was-preventable/ "https://alpolitics.com/case-dixon-d-c-attack-exposes-dangers-of-reckless-afghan-visa-expansion-this-was-preventable/")

* [Criticizing my opponent’s support for the FY2026 NDAA](https://alpolitics.com/dixon-criticizes-rep-gary-palmers-support-of-ndaa-citing-disconnect-between-washington-and-working-families/ "https://alpolitics.com/dixon-criticizes-rep-gary-palmers-support-of-ndaa-citing-disconnect-between-washington-and-working-families/")

**I also had four opinion pieces published recently:**
**
**
1. ["Epstein files – fact or fiction?"](https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-epstein-files-fact-or-fiction "https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-epstein-files-fact-or-fiction")

2. ["Washington claims economic power — Alabama knows better"](https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-washington-claims-economic-power-alabama-knows-better "https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-washington-claims-economic-power-alabama-knows-better")

3. ["Abortion is murder – there are no exceptions"](https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-abortion-is-murder-there-are-no-exceptions "https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-abortion-is-murder-there-are-no-exceptions")

4. ["If this is the ‘most pro-life administration in history,’ it’s time to prove it"](https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-if-this-is-the-most-pro-life-administration-in-history-its-time-to-prove-it "https://1819news.com/news/item/case-dixon-if-this-is-the-most-pro-life-administration-in-history-its-time-to-prove-it")

**Out In The District**

I’ve stayed busy meeting with voters and grassroots leaders, and speaking at or attending events hosted by Republican Women’s clubs, county parties, advocacy groups, Turning Point USA, and more.
My wife and I especially enjoyed spending time with the Elmore County Republican Women, pitching in on their bagged-lunch fundraiser to support the local fire department.
We also had a great time closing out the season by participating in the Alabaster City Christmas Parade.

**VERY IMPORTANT**

We’re coming up on an important end-of-year fundraising **deadline** on **Wednesday, 12/31/25**. How we finish this quarter affects how we plan going into the new year — outreach, early media, and how quickly we can expand the campaign.

If you’re able, I’m asking you to consider making an end-of-year contribution. Even a modest donation helps us start the new year in a stronger position.
[DONATE HERE](https://secure.winred.com/dixon-for-us-congress/donate-today-2d26b569160a252d "https://secure.winred.com/dixon-for-us-congress/donate-today-2d26b569160a252d")
[VOLUNTEER HERE](https://secure.winred.com/dixon-for-us-congress/volunteer-648069d0d32c0b62 "https://secure.winred.com/dixon-for-us-congress/volunteer-648069d0d32c0b62")
Once again, **thank you** to those who have already given their time and support. Your commitment continues to move this campaign forward.
**Stay Up-To-Date**
You can also follow and share our updates here:
[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/case.dixon.98?mibextid=wwXIfr&rdid=RLh8dtJQXl3TTUvv&share_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fshare%2F1ASpp8yLsG%2F%3Fmibextid%3DwwXIfr# "https://www.facebook.com/case.dixon.98?mibextid=wwXIfr&rdid=RLh8dtJQXl3TTUvv&share_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fshare%2F1ASpp8yLsG%2F%3Fmibextid%3DwwXIfr#") | [ X (Twitter)](https://x.com/case_dixon?s=11 "https://x.com/case_dixon?s=11") | [ Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/case_dixon/?igsh=MWV2ZDBtanNyaGtuOA%3D%3D# "https://www.instagram.com/case_dixon/?igsh=MWV2ZDBtanNyaGtuOA%3D%3D#") | [ TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@case_dixon?_t=ZT-8vmmo8vQj9C&_r=1 "https://www.tiktok.com/@case_dixon?_t=ZT-8vmmo8vQj9C&_r=1")

And if you know someone who would want to be part of this effort, please forward this email along.
**Thank you for your continued prayers and support. With God’s help and faithful partners, real reform in Washington is possible.**
**
**
**In Liberty,**
**Case Dixon **
Dixon for Congress
****
Dixon for Congress
(205) 282-9103
615 Brooklane Dr. #3218
Hueytown, AL 35023-2508
DIXONFORUSCONGRESS.COM

| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsp2jb790idjg2shim3nhco3fk8651lnk2ppvvt8_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztkn6q968rj63652unnfob9k085u8isnvk7bn0s0_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqa6in2keqj4adlc0ndkvkg8enh3comsujdtv78g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbggdnd7l1cudvgvs5ibmh3ek8icbq21avsog4m0_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcafesi9s53nh90tgdqan38re320ot6tqlpkgn6g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl2u4t28pq1j2mh8rh3b2pa6rn69jaqsm2uppvoo_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z36o2a93svva634ngs0pt3sgrtni7b31t4d2h3q8_rp22sh2s8i6eor7c1ie4ob3cph2bs)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote

It opened my eyes to how broken our systems are - and I couldn't believe that our members of Congress weren't doing more to fix them. So that's what I'm doing: I'm running for Congress to stand up for the dignity and care of families in my hometown.
That means protecting Social Security and Medicare. It means working to bring down the cost of everything from prescription drugs to groceries. It means creating good-paying jobs and opportunities right here at home.
I just outraised Boebert 5 to 1 and in 2024 when I went head to head with her we the best performance a Democrat has ever had in this district while she underperformed Trump in every county. Now it's time to finish the job.

| Dear Peter,
As we close out the year, I want to take a moment to personally thank you.
Because of your support, our campaign for Florida's 23rd Congressional District continues to grow and lead the Republican field. We've expanded our grassroots operation throughout South Florida and built a coalition of leaders who believe in the direction of this campaign.
To date, our campaign has earned the support of [25 elected officials and community leaders, including five Members of Congress. ](https://km78svhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001C75UOeXgjYcbc3fSKQrC0Gcfgy8B9pAQ66dPIzjcPCIb0Ab_uInRgGmD-k-cvhvFFbfmiNXfTXH9KYBpE3GL7iMEIGpifMwJ3NWo-5BbA2wDscSuKeGWor2Fv3IIaaF2uK8nGsaBe3gyl3ih5mJXNpHP1RAjZv5KrTpLYOpcsQG3iBK2zqySxQ==&c=CWof0qLI1GRvunjSKiS4Nu_meZj-H4hXByWMdBPDpP0nnjovT8M6jQ==&ch=RSDBE2p9OpeHbjP7EJv2BdQF2gdWU-y45BDyS3oLVuqMBR-DE3G_Bg==)Their endorsements reflect confidence in our message and our ability to win.
What I continue to hear from voters across the district is clear: they want steady, principled leadership in Washington that focuses on results, accountability, and service.
As a veteran, service shapes how I approach leadership and public life. I believe in a strong national defense, respect for the rule of law, and a federal government that is accountable to the people it serves.
Closing 2025 strong allows us to keep building, communicating, and preparing for the work ahead in 2026. We've made important progress this year, but the final days of the year matter.
Will you help us raise an additional $10,000 before January 1st?
[Your contribution of up to $3500 maximum per person will help us build the momentum necessary to spread our message, engage voters, and ensure we have the resources to win next November.](https://km78svhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001C75UOeXgjYcbc3fSKQrC0Gcfgy8B9pAQ66dPIzjcPCIb0Ab_uInRgPxUJUetTcgy2w1AD2i5nyrPcSAqALcsl5dsPf_VYaXox7nCJtbU_H0yzJO0nQXCRVS7bNV8vAvZmvg2eQvcJYtjlK7c6Q3hDVw3GUshXYU4htHq-KhnmnO6CEFR4PAlIyn7ZzwmS6nDkXeJOc0MaOHnPxlcTLM0Tw==&c=CWof0qLI1GRvunjSKiS4Nu_meZj-H4hXByWMdBPDpP0nnjovT8M6jQ==&ch=RSDBE2p9OpeHbjP7EJv2BdQF2gdWU-y45BDyS3oLVuqMBR-DE3G_Bg==)
If you've already given, please forward this to your friends and families and encourage them to contribute.
As we look ahead to 2026, I'm encouraged by the campaign we've built and grateful for the support that has brought us this far. I hope you'll continue to stand with us as we carry this campaign forward. Thank you for being part of this effort.

## China's Military Sends Taiwan Warning
China launched two days of live-fire military drills around Taiwan on Monday in exercises code-named [Justice Mission 2025,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uhDAQBeDTmM5oGFh-Chdp6DZtSjTYwzKR-ZFtrbO3j1gpJ0g30khP73tf9-lO4mV_fNLGJi3HtHOOnlPiMNlVdoqbeEkUXln2xCGmI2wTAt50hbqGyZH419QUzizMyHXBpuraDgbsoClWQwS963saqO2hQ6ob11tc2mGu6r6zXIi50iqsoargBlgCLDTAPMxLa28WrGqAnaQjlN-H7Gnlxb-OJ4fSHlvhzZrSGVX9oXBUOOacSzvHS3H9FY7XqXB8Y3QiybRrL0_WiwTWfzrtgngfdaBTnA4cz2OPrPmHg5XICsciGHdm8V5i26kGHhuJf3dI_xruafA3AAD__x90hVQ) simulating blockades of key ports with destroyers, frigates, fighters, bombers, and drones. Taiwan condemned the [military intimidation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpDAQRk9jMiO7-A8cbIK0QW-ywYSoMAXUyNgt22qG249oaU4waZX09N738ZgeyI799g8PMnkNk6czOcqZ4mR39pgOdpwxXif7TDHlEI8JFDRSg6zUtCC7a6qLxaxEQFVBRndtpwboVF3spu4t9brtuwEJlx6qoYO5nWkZ7kNDBZubpqFSWqtGQanUioOah3ltbWOVFbWihXOI5Wdgn3da3RVeFEsbjsKZPednEtUfAaOAEWd7F5RbuN8Cxr-3tcfMwaMTMJ4c6X8O8RIw3oGUSP4kypRxI7lEdi7JjHyilydGL-nrTXFyDdFSkhr6rtbQVkU0y_Nk5zi1najVdiC7t1n-1ZwvA98BAAD__xZZjMg) and deployed forces for a rapid response exercise after detecting 89 Chinese military aircraft and 28 warships near the island. The drills followed [Japan's prime minister](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0E2q2zAUxfHVyDMFWXLsZKBBHsWz10kLHZpr6Sq-RR9GkiOy--KWruCNDxz4_X99Lp9AnuLzOwTU1aUlYisea8W8mI0ilECeKuR3o1gxl5pyWKSQV95LrsRigfx7GTqrHaJE1aHup3ESdzmJods0rmqS19Hd1ptzDsFYhFs_CgCBOFjVkT7feqlE34urkBchHNzFel_daK5GGDYItFRTvvxOFOuGzr_TC_PFpNB5vdW6F6YeTM5Mzq21Syjx3JicMfKjMDmfqHNM2Vsm538w_l_Gt-Rt4Z5eyG0m7wuHnI5oeQVqEDm4ipnXfISdQw6FF_DIIcZ0RIMBY2Vyhswfj_6nifTB1JwMWaa-fZxpsZUfmPcua7s38p7KOLFBPAOQ_4uoXyr_0vJPAAAA___AlJzt) saying its military could intervene if China moved against Taiwan, and the U.S. announcing a record $10 billion arms package for Taipei. Beijing warned that "external forces" arming Taiwan would push the Taiwan Strait into a "perilous situation of imminent war," with the exercises disrupting [over 100,000 passengers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uozAQBeCngc5oGP6WwsU2dNl2S2TsIcyusSN7iJW3v0qk-wS3Pzo63_l7W2-GPYf7H3OSlj2ugUr2JEJptQcHk0_2LCa9CgehlCWmc0XAQbWoOlidYf9a-9rpnQipq0m30zjBjBP09aH3dugngmEbBnR2xq0nswH-GnfaHNBcs363tdhB28IA2ADsZoZt3vbRDhZs1QM5lpiaf5GDHLT7V3xSamw8a68PkUeuut8VLhUupZTGxivJEa9Mb8w7VuHywagjepfVN0m5xN5nZVK8glNiuJigMp-XN8Lhrh4xSVabj_a_cVThUiftHoW95zxOVQ_307D_DJEfvffU-BUAAP__wnCIhg) on scheduled international flights.
## Winter Storm Threatens Midwest, Northeast
A powerful winter storm swept across the Midwest into the Northeast on Monday, threatening to become a "[bomb cyclone](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE8DmVHbwACBg03IZtMNUdu0B-_6Z2S3BnH7FXOFLyvpSaVX9ee5PdEHn16_MZJml7dEZw3ETGWzh09Yow-esVynT0ylci5xU6BGIZXoYdvRh2sb2l07IkV9S1pOjwkWNcHQHnqZyRLZeUYacZbkhnFRIxmQi5V2MK3Xd5tUPUgJI6gOwOECZjHuYUcLthmAds-5dH-zT3yQC1f-UOlsjm3QB_O7Nv2vRq2NWs_z7Kyp94qbN2q94w2--uLrL0yORtjLhpxIvAohi4D_qApMu0i58EFYWUR8VxGQqbJwuZDFyo1a26L39-lD8PUxNQO8IvrwteEfXfjR6n8AAAD__y4yibU)" as Arctic air collided with warmer Southern temperatures. The storm brought [blizzard conditions and](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOkfGEEgKF2no3lYrvRIN9vh5do2N7Eks_n4Fv7DtGelozv3-Wr6AAsWfX7ChZpeWiLUEZMa8GE8RykaBGPJRKTLmwilvi5LqLjolerlYoHAsQ2u1Q1TYt6i7aZzkU01yaL1Wj_EBU-9G-3w4Y-ywrvhwTiK4yYz3tSV92jrVy66Td6luUjp4yvW5utHcjTTNINESp3z7kyiyRxeO9MF8M2lrg_bMe2n6V6PmRs211ttW4nlr1IxRvMtJEdhjbtTMaT8TCC98JYmrSVgq-b1zEe8ifApk4RCc4YNBbGQrFhYxZfYIhYUDg6LEVEWlaAX7jMCnErJ4vbrf8O3-tlnbvVIIVMapGeTPBhSup_m_lv5o9S8AAP__uhiYTQ) up to 2 feet of snow to parts of Michigan and upstate New York, with wind gusts reaching 75 mph and nearly 10 million people under winter storm warnings. Minnesota officials [authorized the National Guard](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOkfGEEgKF2no3lYrvRIN9vh5do2N7Eks_n4Fv7DtGelozv3-Wr6AAsWfX7ChZpeWiLUEZMa8GE8RykaBGPJRKTLmwilvi5LqLjolerlYoHAsQ2u1Q1TYt6i7aZzkU01yaL1Wj_EBU-9G-3w4Y-ywrvhwTiK4yYz3tSV92jrVy66Td6luUjp4yvW5utHcjTTNINESp3z7kyiyRxeO9MF8M2lrg_bMe2n6V6PmRs211ttW4nlr1IxRvMtJEdhjbtTMaT8TCC98JYmrSVgq-b1zEe8ifApk4RCc4YNBbGQrFhYxZfYIhYUDg6LEVEWlaAX7jMCnErJ4vbrf8O3-tlnbvVIIVMapGeTPBhSup_m_lv5o9S8AAP__uhiYTQ) to support emergency operations as sections of Interstate 35 closed due to numerous crashes, while meteorologists warned of "dangerous, potentially life-threatening" travel conditions. The system disrupted holiday travel, with over 7,700 flight delays, while dangerous ice accumulation was expected across New England.

Taiwan condemned the and deployed forces for a rapid response exercise after detecting 89 Chinese military aircraft and 28 warships near the island. The drills followed saying its military could intervene if China moved against Taiwan, and the U.S. announcing a record $10 billion arms package for Taipei. Beijing warned that "external forces" arming Taiwan would push the Taiwan Strait into a "perilous situation of imminent war," with the exercises disrupting on scheduled international flights. The storm brought up to 2 feet of snow to parts of Michigan and upstate New York, with wind gusts reaching 75 mph and nearly 10 million people under winter storm warnings. Minnesota officials to support emergency operations as sections of Interstate 35 closed due to numerous crashes, while meteorologists warned of "dangerous, potentially life-threatening" travel conditions. The system disrupted holiday travel, with over 7,700 flight delays, while dangerous ice accumulation was expected across New England. Alaska received the second-largest award at $272 million, just under Texas's $281 million, following hours of negotiations with whose vote proved critical to passing the megabill. I’ve always believed that a good day starts with a productive morning. I
worked long hours as a district attorney when my daughter was little, so
I've gotten my A.M. routine down to a science:

* Wake up at 5 AM
* Enjoy a little me-time — make coffee, clear my head, watch the sun
rise
* Squeeze in a quick workout
* Cook breakfast
* Put my game face on

Then I’m out the door to Capitol Hill, meetings with Marylanders, or
community events!

Around finance benchmarks (like our End-of-Year FEC fundraising deadline
tomorrow), I add one item to the list:

* Draft a quick email asking for your [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/39271?t=1008&amount=10&akid=3422%2E52803%2ElBjkpe ]$5 or $10 contribution to help
knock out our $$ target as soon as possible! [3]📩

Your support helps me do good work and communicate frequently with the
people of Maryland. That isn’t always easy (especially not with this
president trying to stop us at every turn), but I’m proud to wake up every
morning and fight for you.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/39271?t=1009&amount=10&akid=3422%2E52803%2ElBjkpe ]Peter, can I count on your contribution before our final
fundraising deadline of 2025? The dollars we raise today and tomorrow will
set our intentions for 2026.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/39271?t=1010&amount=10&akid=3422%2E52803%2ElBjkpe ]Chip in!

Whether or not you can give today, I wish you a productive and positive
Tuesday!

— Angela

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. | | Friends,
As we approach the New Year, I want to take a moment to reflect on the road we have traveled together and where we are headed next.
The last five months have felt like a whirlwind. In that time, I have:

* Visited 65 counties
* Attended more than 125 campaign events
* Made over 1,200 calls to delegates
* Logged more than 30,000 miles on my vehicles

That mileage even came with a new transmission and catalytic converter, but that is what happens when you commit fully to meeting people where they are, all across our state.
None of this would be possible without my family, especially my wife Mina and my son Nic, whose support makes this work possible. I am also grateful to the entire team at TBG for their dedication and professionalism.
Most importantly, I want to thank the delegates, county parties, and district leaders who have welcomed me, offered guidance, and placed their trust in this campaign. I am especially thankful for the endorsements I have received so far. Each one is meaningful, and I do not take that support lightly.
As we look ahead to 2026, my commitment is simple: to continue showing up, listening, and earning your trust. I welcome your calls, your questions, and your feedback, and I encourage you to reach out anytime. If you believe in the direction of this campaign, I would be honored to earn your endorsement as well.
There is more work to do, and I am energized by what lies ahead.
I hope you had a very Merry Christmas and a blessed holiday season, and I wish you and your families a happy, healthy, and successful New Year.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

clean_body: Looking Ahead and Staying Connected | | | | | == | | | == | | Friends, As we approach the New Year, I want to take a moment to reflect on the road we have traveled together and where we are headed next. The last five months have felt like a whirlwind. In that time, I have: Visited 65 counties Attended more than 125 campaign events Made over 1,200 calls to delegates Logged more than 30,000 miles on my vehicles That mileage even came with a new transmission and catalytic converter, but that is what happens when you commit fully to meeting people where they are, all across our state. None of this would be possible without my family, especially my wife Mina and my son Nic, whose support makes this work possible. I am also grateful to the entire team at TBG for their dedication and professionalism. Most importantly, I want to thank the delegates, county parties, and district leaders who have welcomed me, offered guidance, and placed their trust in this campaign. I am especially thankful for the endorsements I have received so far. Each one is meaningful, and I do not take that support lightly. As we look ahead to 2026, my commitment is simple: to continue showing up, listening, and earning your trust. I welcome your calls, your questions, and your feedback, and I encourage you to reach out anytime. If you believe in the direction of this campaign, I would be honored to earn your endorsement as well. There is more work to do, and I am energized by what lies ahead. I hope you had a very Merry Christmas and a blessed holiday season, and I wish you and your families a happy, healthy, and successful New Year. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Before we begin 2026…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I still believe in an America that works for all of us.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2738%2E4032634%2EoUB07k)
---
As I look ahead to 2026, I still believe in an America that works for all of us. I believe we can create a vision of big, structural change that will charge us forward. In order to accomplish that, Democrats must fight like hell for policies and ideas that will make transformational change for working people — even if it bothers billionaires. That’s what the American people want and deserve. That’s why I recently launched Fight PAC: An organization to support, uplift, and help elect fighters for the working class to Congress. Fight PAC is all about:
* Electing leaders who understand what it really means, and looks like, to fight for working families. (Hint: it’s more than a strongly-worded letter.)
* Supporting Democrats who will take a stand when it’s hard and speak truth to power.
* Refusing corporate PAC checks — even when it would be easier to take them — because corporations have way too much control over our democracy.
* Unapologetically proposing bold economic reforms — not just small measures that nibble around the edges.

[**If you’re in the position to make a contribution right now to support Fight PAC and our campaign as we head into 2026, you’ll ensure we have the resources we need to win BIG in the midterms — and win big with Democrats who are going to fight like hell for the working class. Will you split a donation today?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3302?t=8&akid=2738%2E4032634%2EoUB07k) Democrats have the chance to take back the House and Senate in November 2026 and I will do everything possible to make that happen. We know that Democrats win when we go out there and fight for the big, structural changes that will make our government and our economy work for working people. We know how to win this, we just need to get out there and fight hard. And it’s not enough just to secure our majorities. That is a critical first step, yes, but we need our majorities to be filled with fighters who are more eager to pass plans that truly transform the lives of working people in this country than they are to make compromises. [**Contributions to Fight PAC will support candidates who are doing just that. So before we start 2026, will you split a contribution between Fight PAC and our campaign to ensure we start the midterms year with the strongest momentum possible and we can execute all of our plans to win?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3302?t=9&akid=2738%2E4032634%2EoUB07k) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

A generous group of donors will match every dollar you donate 4X, up to $50,000. Before midnight, your generosity can help provide critical support and services for our heroes. From a sheriff... and a father. | | | [](http://links.gopwins.info/u/click?_t=98057da4e99f4c609080f212fe1184e1&_m=16241571df914e0b8a5eb03997585a6f&_e=gesCUab_KNnXk329z4VugGbGykoRarPqj5HJ6oN2kQHsBzAn09kvSYR65eT74FJDGi5fzzSLwRnNn0dl5X1G0dsf1wH0N-vk7_8vOVzIHHjTW-YO7f3X86G8RKgNbmHh3a37JFzAfrfzpZh9GFIqaZHxuUAArbqjQ6oOb6TMkEB-Lxxk2NfHPHg3TKFEXPVRLFtTT9sNN-JcYFvwnWDX8Win4HKwMlXWezGro2AUgcMqTs6EX_8E0WBqljqiJA45jlB1qV_845I6wb4aC3grcfj4t3yqrecxMldK_-vJULN4ggTCwNgOz_P0PKeOs5DYnX8cNFpW2u8UOxLpZP_g_j4-SXASybnhAB-1JGwW1lBnLwyHHGqC2zhIPEzDcvIfLVV51zoDX1HNWGrOedLLpaKyWZzq_LmY7L4WaTx_QKE3f-S7XobN3T9fHx53eeG6vwHVIK4CQJaQ1FIrDD7Jk_WDNBjmslT7vt19Ux6cFybYMRXywnBxehhFPekmLzp9uuFDy4iMgaep7ni7JqQ7jvlT4OOSMrJCbhQiOBpkJMgbP5SkA6GEucyB6yvYVsnrtPDhGpMTGtVqna95BcACY76bCvzXp1zG4cq1-MGGrAt06pQihLqdK8PjSUUfILYmFDozMZyPs0rPeM8mfpF3jSFcR5zC5FSv9YMop3QPXCMOcELTQ-lrCCFGhLA0zwcZxERRSTaOYNASnOWXuNyKGhM67KXs15bxLGaqbNYN5vrN-1xvcsSbxXjeAXe9oVGO-uAovHMQr6jZyuhTgExUBWV2PLEcBuVR0lMY8TgrqfrfkNrfHCpPPB9oADzy-PdLo9zCVkxkMmYqrox8mNbxCQ%3D%3D)

This is Sheriff Mike Bouchard — but today, I’m writing to you simply as a father.
I’ve spent decades serving our community in law enforcement. I’ve seen crisis, loss, sacrifice.
I’ve watched families get that knock on the door no parent ever wants.
And when my son Mike chose to serve this country, I knew exactly what that decision meant.
I knew he would be putting his life on the line.
I knew our family would live with the quiet fear only military families truly understand.
And I knew there was a chance he might not come home.
But like every patriotic soldier, he didn’t hesitate.
_**That’s who Mike has always been — even as a kid.**_
He ran toward responsibility, toward challenges, toward the hard things that build a man’s character.
And over the last decade, I watched him serve in ways that made me both proud and humbled as his father:
I watched him jump out of planes as a paratrooper.
I watched him deploy to Iraq and live under constant threat — rockets, drones, militias.
I watched him lead missions that protected thousands of American troops.
I watched him volunteer to go back with only 20 days’ notice.
And when he walked off that plane after nine months in a combat zone... he didn’t talk about what he endured.
**_He talked about what our country needed._**
That’s when I knew his mission wasn’t finished.
Mike stepped into this race for Congress because he sees the same danger here at home that he saw overseas: weakness, division, and leaders who have forgotten what service means.
But he’s stepping in late — because he was serving his country.
And that means he is now facing the toughest moment of any campaign: **his first-ever year-end deadline — the one that determines whether this mission survives.**

clean_body: From a sheriff... and a father. | | | This is Sheriff Mike Bouchard — but today, I’m writing to you simply as a father. I’ve spent decades serving our community in law enforcement. I’ve seen crisis, loss, sacrifice. I’ve watched families get that knock on the door no parent ever wants. And when my son Mike chose to serve this country, I knew exactly what that decision meant. I knew he would be putting his life on the line. I knew our family would live with the quiet fear only military families truly understand. And I knew there was a chance he might not come home. But like every patriotic soldier, he didn’t hesitate. That’s who Mike has always been — even as a kid. He ran toward responsibility, toward challenges, toward the hard things that build a man’s character. And over the last decade, I watched him serve in ways that made me both proud and humbled as his father: I watched him jump out of planes as a paratrooper. I watched him deploy to Iraq and live under constant threat — rockets, drones, militias. I watched him lead missions that protected thousands of American troops. I watched him volunteer to go back with only 20 days’ notice. And when he walked off that plane after nine months in a combat zone... he didn’t talk about what he endured. He talked about what our country needed. That’s when I knew his mission wasn’t finished. Mike stepped into this race for Congress because he sees the same danger here at home that he saw overseas: weakness, division, and leaders who have forgotten what service means. But he’s stepping in late — because he was serving his country. And that means he is now facing the toughest moment of any campaign: his first-ever year-end deadline — the one that determines whether this mission survives. As someone who has spent his life in public service, I can tell you: early numbers matter. They tell the political world whether a candidate has real support... or whether they can be dismissed before the fight even begins. Mike doesn’t quit. He doesn’t back down. He has spent his life protecting others. Now he wants to protect this community — and this country. Thank you for reading this. It means more to me than you know. With respect, Sheriff Michael Bouchard Proud father of Captain Mike Bouchard | | Friends of Michael Bouchard, Inc. | | USE OF MILITARY RANK, JOB TITLES AND PHOTOGRAPHS IN UNIFORM DOES NOT IMPLY ENDORSEMENT BY THE DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY, THE DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY, OR THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
Hey, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got the entire executive branch bearing down on me right now.
After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.

| | Dorian Gray glanced at the picture, and suddenly an uncontrollable feeling of hatred for Basil Hallward came over him, as though it had been suggested to him by the image on the canvas, whispered into his ear by those grinning lips. The mad passions of a hunted animal stirred within him, and he loathed the man who was seated at the table, more than in his whole life he had ever loathed anything. He glanced wildly around. Something glimmered on the top of the painted chest that faced him. His eye fell on it. He knew what it was. It was a knife that he had brought up, some days before, to cut a piece of cord, and had forgotten to take away with him. He moved slowly towards it, passing Hallward as he did so. As soon as he got behind him, he seized it and turned round. Hallward stirred in his chair as if he was going to rise. He rushed at him and dug the knife into the great vein that is behind the ear, crushing the man’s head down on the table and stabbing again and again. There was a stifled groan and the horrible sound of some one choking with blood. Three times the outstretched arms shot up convulsively, waving grotesque, stiff-fingered hands in the air. He stabbed him twice more, but the man did not move. Something began to trickle on the floor. He waited for a moment, still pressing the head down. Then he threw the knife on the table, and listened. He could hear nothing, but the drip, drip on the threadbare carpet. He opened the door and went out on the landing. The house was absolutely quiet. No one was about. For a few seconds he stood bending over the balustrade and peering down into the black seething well of darkness. Then he took out the key and returned to the room, locking himself in as he did so. The thing was still seated in the chair, straining over the table with bowed head, and humped back, and long fantastic arms. Had it not been for the red jagged tear in the neck and the clotted black pool that was slowly widening on the table, one would have said that the man was simply asleep. How quickly it had all been done! He felt strangely calm, and walking over to the window, opened it and stepped out on the balcony. The wind had blown the fog away, and the sky was like a monstrous peacock’s tail, starred with myriads of golden eyes. He looked down and saw the policeman going his rounds and flashing the long beam of his lantern on the doors of the silent houses. The crimson spot of a prowling hansom gleamed at the corner and then vanished. A woman in a fluttering shawl was creeping slowly by the railings, staggering as she went. Now and then she stopped and peered back. Once, she began to sing in a hoarse voice. The policeman strolled over and said something to her. She stumbled away, laughing. A bitter blast swept across the square. The gas-lamps flickered and became blue, and the leafless trees shook their black iron branches to and fro. He shivered and went back, closing the window behind him.
